status_meaning: Source and six-case preparation are admitted for twelve bounded forwards; no outcome or capability prediction.
reviewer: Independent method reviewer; source and saved-token inspection without model or tokenizer execution.
checks: All six full-input/target token lists match the fixed preparation and independent alignment record; prompt prefixes match historical input-token hashes.
Original targets remain unchanged: JSON body, EOS 151645 and one post-EOS newline 198. Matching through EOS is not a semantic error.

The L+1 logit tail discards its last position and predicts each of the L target IDs with the preceding hidden position; scalar and per-token statistics share that alignment.
One forward call site is used exactly once per six-case arm, enabled then disabled. No generate, optimizer, backward, alternative candidate or retry path exists.
Both arms use one loaded base/adapter object, fixed precision, full target sequences, use_cache=False, eval and inference_mode.

Every forward checks the same active adapter and all 336 layer enable/disable flags, plus zero trainability. A finally block refreezes immediately after PEFT context restoration and rechecks enabled state.
Rank uses strictly-greater logits; ties are explicit, argmax is distinct from rank-one. Logprob margins use the same normalization and on-minus-off pairs use identical target positions.
The independently reviewed CPU preparation contains four index checks and a tiny tensor arithmetic control; this review does not repeat them or load weights.
interpretation_limits: The permitted outcome claim is the adapter toggle's conditional effect on these fixed target positions and first-divergence token pairs. It is not a probability of complete semantic repair.
The English owner token 788 is a colon, and the two token-9207 alternatives end an object; none alone logically forces the subsequent empty/closed-list outcome.
After the first differing token, canonical teacher forcing supplies a different history from the old free output. Later likelihood cannot demonstrate autonomous recovery.
The successful Chinese withdrawal wording difference is not an error; the Chinese uncertainty EOS match has no observed post-EOS competing token.
Full-sequence no-cache scores may rank tokens differently from historical cached greedy decoding. Such differences must be retained and prevent claims of exact historical replay.
Six exposed training examples and fixed nonrandomized arm order cannot establish generalization, whole-training-set fit, a training-data cause, or production readiness.
stop_policy: At most the twelve frozen assignments; stop on first runtime failure, retain every attempt, do not resume/retry or add candidates/generations.
